_comment: The Internet Archive setlist source. `enabled` is the one switch for every band below: set it to false and the app stops resolving them to the Archive (lib/setlistSources.js), /api/band-setlist refuses source=archive without a request (netlify/functions/band-setlist.js, which also covers app builds already installed), the adapter makes no request whoever calls it (netlify/functions/lib/archiveAdapter.js), and admin-resync-setlists skips them. New adds then keep setlist.fm's setlist. Setlists already saved from the Archive stay as they are and keep their attribution. Read by lib/__tests__/archiveSwitch.test.js. Each entry in `artists` is one band, opt-in, never inferred: `artistId` is what the app sends as /api/band-setlist's artistId; `collection` is the Archive collection searched, and `creators` (Live Music Archive bands only) the exact creator values kept from it, so a tribute act or side project whose creator merely contains the name is never read; `aliases` are other spellings of the band's name in show documents. Optional per band: `protectedGroup` is passed to the merge rule (titles whose absence from a tape is not believed; see protectGroup in lib/bandSetlistMerge.js); `excludedDates` are dates the Archive is not asked about at all, so new adds and the backfill keep setlist.fm's setlist, each value saying why; `titleAliases` maps a taper spelling (lowercase) to the title the song index uses. How each band was chosen: docs/setlist-sources/internet-archive.md.
